title: Gaussian entropy makes localization in the low Wick-square region cost logarithmically divergent free energy

entropy_localization.low_potential_set: Let A_N={W_N<=3 C_N^2}, half the free-vacuum mean. K1470 and Chebyshev give delta_N=mu(A_N)=O(N^-3)
entropy_localization.binary_entropy_contraction: For normalized psi, f=|psi|^2 and m_N=int_A_N f dmu, data processing of relative entropy gives Ent_mu(f)>=m_N log(1/delta_N)-log 2
entropy_localization.gaussian_log_sobolev: For H0=dGamma(omega) with omega>=omega0>0, Gross log-Sobolev gives Ent_mu(|psi|^2)<=c_LS q0[psi] with a cutoff-independent c_LS, for example c_LS=2/omega0 in the standard Q-space convention
entropy_localization.mass_bound: Combining the inequalities gives m_N<=(c_LS q0[psi]+log 2)/log(1/delta_N)
entropy_localization.dichotomy: For large N, either q0[psi]>=log(1/delta_N)/(4 c_LS), or m_N<=1/2 and int W_N |psi|^2 dmu >=(3/2) C_N^2
entropy_localization.energy_consequence: At every fixed g>0, q_N[psi]=q0[psi]+g int W_N|psi|^2 obeys inf q_N>=min(log(1/delta_N)/(4 c_LS),(3g/2)C_N^2)=Omega(log N)
entropy_localization.ceiling: The logarithmic lower bound concerns the unshifted nonnegative square-completed family in the fixed Gaussian representation. It does not determine the ground-energy asymptotic or exclude a ground-energy-recentered Mosco limit, singular dressing or changed representation
